verdict.rationale: Render's own CLI docs say the CLI "supports non-interactive use in scripts and CI/CD", which directly covers headless and CI automation. A REST API with a live OpenAPI spec adds a programmatic path, and the CLI can validate render.yaml Blueprints in pipelines. missing for 10: details of non-interactive mode in the pack (CI auth via API key/token, machine-readable output formats), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
